items.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
items.content: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
items.content: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.

items.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
items.content: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.

items.title: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
items.content: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.

items.title: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
items.content: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.

items.title: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September
items.content: Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives.

items.title: Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings
items.content: Barclays reported a $187 million stake as of Sept. 30, while Citigroup disclosed a new $119 million position in Fidelity’s Bitcoin ETF.

items.title: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks
items.content: The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.

items.title: Bitcoin short-term holders send 47K BTC to exchanges at a loss
items.content: Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders’ average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant.

items.title: Bitget Wallet reports sevenfold jump in crypto phishing risk alerts
items.content: The wallet flagged about 37,000 signing requests a week for phishing in Q3 and said better monitoring likely contributed to the increase.

items.title: Bitmine posts $6.3B net loss for fiscal 2026 as Ether prices slide
items.content: Bitmine booked $6.2 billion in unrealized losses on digital assets. It held 6.07 million ETH on Sunday, or 4.97% of Ether’s supply.

items.title: ECB warns legislative delays could postpone digital euro launch
items.content: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone warned EU lawmakers that delays in finalizing digital euro legislation could push back its potential 2029 rollout.

items.title: Stock ETF buyers pounce on dip as Bitcoin funds bleed $1.6 billion
items.content: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have lost $1.6 billion in November, while stock funds attracted billions of dollars from investors buying the dip.

items.title: SEC enforcement actions fall 24%, crypto cases in spotlight
items.content: The SEC filed 348 actions in fiscal 2026, down from 456 a year earlier. Cases included alleged Bitcoin mining fraud and an FTX audit settlement.

items.title: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
items.content: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.

items.title: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain
items.content: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.

items.title: Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip
items.content: The Minnesota lawmaker, who helped establish the Congressional Crypto Caucus, will stay on as Republican whip after Democrats won the midterms.

items.title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
items.content: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.

items.title: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
items.content: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.

items.title: Global banks commit $270M to stablecoin venture targeting 2027 launch
items.content: Project Faro, backed by Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and BBVA, has secured $270 million in funding to launch a US dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027.

items.title: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
items.content: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.

items.title: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
items.content: The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform.

items.title: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
items.content: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.

items.title: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
items.content: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
items.content: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

items.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
items.content: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.

items.title: Polymarket US trading volume jumps 266% despite regulatory battles
items.content: Trading volume on Polymarket’s US exchange surged from June to October, fueled by sports betting, even as the platform faces mounting regulatory scrutiny.

items.title: Bitcoin nears 11-week low after ‘discouraging’ US CPI inflation beat
items.content: Bitcoin and US stocks initially fall after October inflation tops forecasts, with traders expecting a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.

items.title: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes
items.content: The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list.
